drhp.business: Incorporated in 1954, the Company operates a single-segment business of sale and distribution of automobile spare parts and accessories across India through its branch network, serving the Indian automotive aftermarket. Most of its suppliers are Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) and it represents 28 leading manufacturers of the Indian automobile industry. Headquartered at Chennai, it has a nationwide footprint with presence in 23 states operating through a network of 99 branches.

drhp.expansion: IMPAL's expansion is distribution-led rather than manufacturing-led: it expanded operations by opening ten new branches during FY2025-26, taking the network to 99 branches spread across 23 states with headquarters at Chennai. Management identifies expanding the dealer network closer to consumption areas — while ensuring timely availability of parts and maintaining cost efficiency — as the key opportunity for sustained growth, supported by its strong presence in smaller cities, towns and rural areas. risks.note: The Company operates in a single segment business of sale and distribution of automobile spare parts and accessories across India, so earnings depend entirely on one product-market with no segment or export diversification (the Company had no foreign exchange earnings).
Most of the Company's suppliers are Original Equipment Manufacturers, making continuity of principal relationships and parts allocation central to the distribution model.
